Take a day trip to Essaouira and immerse yourself in the unique atmosphere of this coastal town. Departing from Marrakech, you’ll pass through magnificent scenery before reaching the medina of Essaouira, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

On the way, a stop at Sidi Kaouki, famous for its wild beaches and bohemian ambience, offers you a moment of relaxation facing the Atlantic. Once in Essaouira, stroll through the medina with its white and blue alleyways, explore the bustling port and admire the imposing ramparts overlooking the ocean.

Enjoy lunch in an Essaouira restaurant, where you can sample fresh fish and local specialties. After a day rich in discoveries, return to Marrakech in the late afternoon.

Why choose this tour?

  • Discover Essaouira’s medina, port and ramparts.
  • Visit Sidi Kaouki, a popular spot for nature lovers and surfers.
  • Taste fresh fish in an Essaouira restaurant.
  • Comfortable transport with pick-up from your accommodation in Marrakech.

Prices and options:

  • 600 Dh (60€) per person
  • 300 Dh (30€) for children aged 3 to 12

What’s included

  • Round-trip transportation from Marrakech.

What is not included:

  • Catering.
